import-model.format: JSON file; source_path is resolved relative to this file

source_path.description: Existing CIF, POSCAR/CONTCAR or extxyz file. The field is source_path.

source_reference.description: Explicit provenance of the supplied structure

phase_requested.description: User-selected phase; do not infer it from a material name

notes: All required strings must be non-empty.
Multiple blocks or frames require explicit source_index.
output is a CLI argument naming a new directory; it is not a request field.
This describes the existing domain input contract. Structure reading, geometry validation and generation run only inside Slurm.

derive-supercell.format: JSON file; parent and output are separate CLI arguments

repeat_matrix.description: Explicit 3 by 3 integer matrix with positive determinant

notes: Use a saved three-dimensional periodic, neutral parent model and a new child identity.
repeat_matrix must come from the selected scientific task; no supercell size is inferred.
Exact supercells repeat existing occupancies and do not resample dopants.

derive-defect.format: JSON file; parent and output are separate CLI arguments

charge_state.description: Explicit total charge; no default or compensation inference

notes: Operations are ordered and refer to saved atom_id values, not array indices.
compensation and random_seed are unsupported here; use explicitly selected operations.
Charge metadata does not establish that a charged DFT method is executable or qualified.
